title: LordSpecialty
description: The lords' talent trees (Lord Specialty page). Names and texts are localized as in pack_data.json.

max_level.description: The highest Specialty level of the current season. Talents unlocking above it only show (and can take points) with the next season's switch on.

lords.description: The lords (classes) to choose from, in the order of the page's switch. Their talents above `max_level` belong to the next season.

next_season.description: The next season (Season 02: Frozen Era): the page's switch for it raises the Specialty level to its `max_level`, enables the lords' talents up to it and adds a tree of its own, `talents`.

id.description: The season's tree in the page's switch and URL (`?lord=`): not a lord's id.

max_level.description: The highest Specialty level of the next season, above the current `max_level`.

talents.description: The season's own talents, which no lord has: a tree in order like a lord's (it is also the build's order in the URL). Their points are not the player's Specialty points.
The talent tree in order (by unlock level, the left talent of a level first). It is also the build's order in the page's URL: reordering or inserting talents changes what shared links mean.

icon.description: Image file in webapp/public/assets/lord/. Without one the tile shows the placeholder icon.

requires.description: A talent of the same tree, listed before this one, that must be at its max level before this one takes points.

unlock_level.description: Specialty level that unlocks the talent.

kind.description: Active talents are used (with a cooldown), passive ones always apply.

max_level.description: Talent levels; each costs one Specialty point. At most 9 (one digit per talent in the URL).

description.description: What the talent does; "{value}" stands for the value at the talent's level (`values`).

values.description: The talent's number per level (one per level, max_level of them), shown in place of "{value}".
